exploratory.narrowing_operation: Scale selected measured deviations about their mean; preserve fixed center. No causal acoustic attribution.
exploratory.endpoint_sensitivity_semantics: Source energy intervals used as corner sensitivities; printed locations +/-0.0005 um rounding allowance. Not statistical CI or comprehensive model uncertainty.
exploratory.adverse_case: Lower jitter can reduce overlap for a misaligned mean; added serial prep can reduce output per time. Stability alone need not change mean energy.
